query:
SELECT e.id
                FROM go_entries e
                JOIN caches c ON c.id = e.cache_id
                WHERE e.id = ANY($1)
                    AND c.org_id = $2
                    AND e.generation = c.go_generation
                    AND e.uploaded_at IS NOT NULL
                    AND e.expires_at > NOW()
                ORDER BY e.id
                FOR UPDATE OF e SKIP LOCKED
